name: VL53L0X Time-of-Flight Distance
description: ST Microelectronics ToF laser ranging sensor with up to 2 m range and ±3% accuracy. More precise than ultrasonic, immune to target reflectivity variation.

signals.description: Measured range to target in millimetres
